scope: Instrumented test floor with fresh release installed Codegen. Shapes: 0 tail numeric chain, 1 warmed Integer operator replaced then restored, 2 mixed Float input, 3 compiler-refused Cell construction, 4 first numeric result returned after the chain. Precise GC; 128 calls then separately timed collection per batch. Id allocation charges match. Saved boxes are before collection. Cold time includes the first 128 calls and hot-kernel preparation; Codegen materialization excludes source parsing and CodeObject creation. Map bytes include owned vector capacity and Rc header, excluding allocator overhead and other native-tier records. Native unit counts are not executable byte sizes. Journal bytes include retained capacity. Darwin time -l records whole-process peak RSS in bytes, including startup and GC. Counter and result checks remain inside execution timing. These are fixture measurements, not application-wide speedups. The shape-3 asCell refusal creates historied Store data that survives collection. Its separately recorded batch count bounds that growth; it is not a steady-state control. Paired configurations use identical counts. This driver changes no fixture body, production source or counter rule.
